pm.test('Cohorts expose known and pending denominators',()=>{const r=pm.response.json().reproduction;pm.expect(r.evaluatedServices+r.pendingServices).to.eql(r.servedFemales);for(const value of [r.pregnancyPercent,r.fertilityPercent])if(value!==null)pm.expect(value).to.be.within(0,100);});

pm.test('Recorded quote declares origin and effective date',()=>{if(pm.response.code===200){const q=pm.response.json();pm.expect(['manual','automatic']).to.include(q.entryMethod);pm.expect(q.bolivarsPerDollar).to.be.above(0);pm.expect(q.effectiveDate<=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)).to.eql(true);}});
